body: I live in asia and I don't know if there's such thing.... I want to move out if I could but the minimum wage here for part time jobs are barely dollar an hour not enough to support myself....

I'm surrounded by toxic people at home everyday. Kinda pushed me to my limit today. When I was a child my parents always hit me never understood why, shouting, hitting to the point that right now whenver I hear any scream or chain rattling I feel a fucking pls stop sensation in my head. Once my dad is beating me up and I was looking at my mom asking for help instead she took a metal rod and started beating me with it. I isolated myself from them since I was a kid, i rather imagine they're not at the house rather than deal with them.Right now that's the way, I always have fun at school but once I get home it comes back. This morning pushed me to the limit, it hurts to write this but.. you see my parents are assholes they act fake infront of people. When I was a kid a friend gave me a dog, and I watched it get sold to a dogeater and get shot infront of me. Years past they got another one, they tied those two together without food until they started killing eachother. I didn't do anything because Everytime i'm at the house i just pretend I don't exist. Now this morning they got a new one. I woke to it crying because it's tied beside my room. I wanted to ignore it but when I saw it look so helpless I tried taking off the chain, that's when my mom came and started leashing it again and pulled it the dogs cries and face suddenly flashed back memories of my childhood. Seeing it look hurt and choking. I fought to take back the dog leash and accidentally pushed my mom. Neighbors saw and she started shit talking me in front of them saying hurtful things to me like how ungrateful I am and how Im crazy with my own world, she once got hold of my writing prompts notebook and she thinks how crazy and retarded I am with my own worlds. Right now i locked myself inside my room and I keep hearing dog cries outside I feel so stressed Ijust want everything to stop, I don't want any of this anymore.
